components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (typically one of MR,
            MRS, MS or DR). When present it is combined with the last name to
            form the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' (and
            optional 'addressLine2') is supplied it is preferred. On read this is
            the composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with
            a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when
            present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized like 'address' on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to 'addressLine1' in the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the
            '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (Sydney/NSW
            2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with
            no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only flag. The householdId is always derived automatically from
            the last name and postcode, so owners sharing those already share a
            household. When true, this flag only bypasses the duplicate block: the
            owner is created as a declared household member even though another owner
            is already in the same household (same last name and postcode, for
            example family members living together), and it is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formed at read time as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the honorific
                'title' and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR
                Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: a '+' and the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678'). Raw 'telephone' stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string

   - AREA = `METRO` when locality ∈ {NSW, VIC, QLD}, else `REGIONAL`.

2. **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — registered `OwnerSegment` in the mapper's `imports` and added a `@Mapping` for `ownerSegment` that feeds it `owner.getMembershipLevel()` and the locality resolved via the existing `OwnerLocality.fromCustomerCode(owner.getCustomerCode())` (the same source the `locality`/`timezone` fields already use, so the segment shares the region identity assigned at creation).

3. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `ownerSegment` string property to the `Owner` schema (the DTO is generated from this spec at build time), documenting the four possible values.

The acceptance tests confirm both cases: a Sydney (NSW) owner at membership level 2 → `STANDARD_METRO`, and an unknown-city owner → `STANDARD_REGIONAL`.
